title: Hello fellow mega mall patrons
content: I have just recently learned there were others experiencing the same dream. I have been cursed by this dream for a few years now. After finally deciding to google it. Seems like there isn't much info out there other than just dream descriptions from others. but that makes sense. There is not much science behind dreams obviously. (Yet) Anyway, the othernight I was woken up by the mall dream due to it being so overwhelming. I wanted to share my mall world description to see if there were other people who experienced the same mall settings as me. somehow this will make me feel better. lol The mall: So the actual mall part of the mall in my dreams alot of times is just really long and wide "hallways" or walkways that have huge domed tops with windows.looks more like an airport really.(which there is one at the mall sometimes) But it's still a mall. There's lots of glass storefronts/doors that lead to the stores, casinos, prison, schools, ect.. sometimes there are escalators or moving walkways. Most of the time there isn't a lot of stairs. it's just a lot of ramps with rails. Many times the mall portion is lit from the sun coming in through the windows. There are doors that lead outside to deck/lounge areas as well. But there is usually one side of these hallways that you can see into the prison. The prison: In most of the dreams, there's a giant prison in the center of the mall. You can view into the prison from the outter mall area that surrounds the center. The mall sides are kinda like really wide hallways. But on one side there's a viewing window to the prison that goes all the way down. And u can just see inmates chilling or eating or sleeping in there bunks. Mess hall areas, bunk house areas, large cell rooms, ect. pretty standard looking prison other then the futuristic vibe. Lots of tall clear windows and doors like the movies "13ghosts". (I am assuming this has something to do with the fact I worked in corrections for around 5 years. Not a D.O. Just to clarify) The School: There is some sort of school attached to the mall because it always goes hand and hand with the mall dream. sometimes, the dream just shifts and I'm there or I go through a mall door Into the school hallways or the school gym. The hallways just seem like never ending hallways of a school that lead to different classrooms of like every grade and highschool. sometimes empty, Sometimes with lots of people. Sometimes they are dimly lit sometimes they are lit from the sun through the windows and doors.you can hear school sounds and theres paper falling occasionally. I've ran through these halls in a panic before trying to escape or get away from someone. There is a massive gym and I remember it vividy because I dream of it alot. It's just a big empty school gym that's usually half lit or pretty dark. There's tall bleachers and on one side of the tall bleachers is a raised flat bleacher area with sound equipment and other gyms stuff that's stored. It's raised up on some kind of metal stands that look like the bleachers. I have slept up here in my dream trying to hide from where was looking for me. It's super tall. The bathrooms: There super weird. Everytime I dream of them they are super long unisex bathrooms. Dimly lit with weird lighting. The stalls are always too short like u can just see over them. Or vice versa and the bottom of the stalls are super high and u can see everything under them and just the very tops are covered instead. The sinks are always old school ceramic but dirty with plumbing sticking out reminds me of matrix in that one bathroom scene. Multiple entrances to them. Idk just super weird. Anytime I dream I'm using them I just feel uncomfortable and want to get out and people come in wile I use it and they look at me like it's weird. I hate that part of mall world lol. The elevators: I often dream of these elevators that seems to keep going forever and super fast and I always feel it in my gut. It feels like a Rollercoaster ride. Even it just goes up or down. But the entrance to the elevator look the same usually. There's a carpeted (usually green) ramp with a handrail in the center that leads to it. There's a square opening in the wall that juts out as a very short and narrow hallway. theres 1 elevator door on either side. It's usually a brown door with a gold design on it that reminds me of a theater. Sometimes there's a trashcan near it aswell. The rooftop/service hallways: I'm often running or hiding in the service hallways. They are just industrial building looking hallways with locked/opend doors and corridors. Boiler rooms,service rooms, trash rooms,enclosed truck docks, storage . Sometimes the hallways are very dirty, trashy rusty. Sometimes they are just regular mall service hallways. But many times it will be night time and lead to an industrial looking rooftop with exhaust stacks and AC units or whatever. Total Mirrors Edge 2 vibes. The casino: A massive casino with slot machines, bars, tables, people eating, dancers, chaos everywhere. Usually pretty dimly lit but more of a chill vibe. There's fake palm trees inside and I usually can see/hear/smell a pretty large fountain. There's large rails that divide the game area from the stores and food. Sort of a margaritaville kinda vibe(I grew up in Las Vegas so I'm pretty sure that's where this comes from) The train: Several dreams have lead me to leaving/going to the mall on a train. But it's more of a cargo train with now freights on it and all the people are just sitting on it. Bundled up being blown by the wind. I can always feel like I'm gonna fall off and it's pretty scary, it feels really real. Anyway. Sorry for the mess of a TLDR. 3am Can't sleep rn and just needed to dump this somewhere. Hope others can relate to my specific mall details.
